title: Register Configuration Invariant
statement: For any input word $x$, bound $B$, program location $l$, and natural numbers $i,p,t,u$ with $i,p,t,u\le B$, the configuration at location $l$ with registers $(i,p,t,u)$ and no answer satisfies the search program's precondition and has every register at most $B$.
hypotheses_covered: The input is $x$; the program location $l$ is arbitrary
